title: Nebraska DOR Revenue Ruling 01-22-1: Rescind Revenue Ruling 01-08-1, Sales and Use Tax Exemption for Qualified Materials for Use in a Community-Based Energy Development Project
text:
Revenue Ruling 01-22-1
Nebraska Sales and Use Tax
January 31, 2022
Revenue Ruling Rescinded
The following revenue ruling is hereby rescinded:
01-08-1 — Sales and Use Tax Exemption for Qualified Materials for Use in a
Community-Based Energy Development Project, issued January 16, 2008.
APPROVED:
Tony Fulton
Tax Commissioner
January 31, 2022
Nebraska Department of Revenue, PO Box 94818, Lincoln, Nebraska 68509-4818
